description.value: Tacoholic is a Mexican fast-food taco shop on Fraser Highway in Langley, BC, operating without a drive-through window. It sits on a busy commercial arterial that touring cyclists on the Trans Canada Trail corridor pass through when moving between Langley and Abbotsford. The Facebook branding as a 'Taco Shop' suggests a casual, quick-service format well suited to a quick refuel stop.
